description: Find and terminate an orphaned process that is holding a file lock or a listen port after a crashed or interrupted session, so the next operation can proceed. Triggers when an operation fails because a file "is being used by another process", when a server or bridge cannot bind its port with "address already in use", when an error names the holder in a `Name (PID)` form, or when the user says "kill zombies", "release the lock", "the port is stuck", or "it is hung".
